description: Ministry of Education - Order made under Section 27(1) Department of Human Biological Sciences University of Jaffna Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order made under statutory powers (Section 27(1) read with Section 21) that modifies the schedule specifying faculties and departments of study at the University of Jaffna. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on amending the legal framework governing university departments rather than government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
